name: POXEL SA POXEL ORD SHS
summary: POXEL SA is a French biopharmaceutical company focused on the development of innovative treatments for metabolic diseases, including type 2 diabetes and non-alcoholic steatohepatitis (NASH). The company's lead product candidate is Imeglimin, an oral antidiabetic agent. POXEL SA is headquartered in Lyon, France.
